text_block_list.name: Stiff-Shoulder Monst...
text_block_list.text:
Kehyahyaha! Prepare yourself, Carrotman! 
I, the Stiff Shoulder Kaijin Gachigod, 
will defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! This monster...
I've seen it before! 
Somewhere, I'm sure of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"The Recycled Monster." It's a
phenomenon 
occasionally seen in the latter half of 
superhero shows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to budget constraints and such, the 
same costume would sometimes reappear
as a 
different enemy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's the Yasuda Kinen! Brace 
yourself, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: âRecycling Monster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Who're you calling recycled?! Well, it's 
true I did race against you once before, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I just had to run one more time! I 
couldn't rest until I cleared away this 
frustration."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated...?
Did I do something to upset 
Big Sis Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I did... Normally,
it's probably something 
I should be grateful for, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You... rekindled Brian's spirit when it 
was on the verge of dying out...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, she was able to return to 
the front line. She'll definitely win the 
Takarazuka Kinen and the autumn GⅠs too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still!! But you see!!
*I* wanted to be the 
one to get her back on her feet!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I couldn't do it... My running 
wasn't enough to fire her up...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So before I beat Brian, I'm beating you! 
You, who pulled off what I couldn't...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't rest until I take you down! 
Come on, let's settle this one-on-one in 
the Mile!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“I see... You mean Brian-san. If that's 
the case...”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, bring it on! I'll show you how 
much stronger my running's gotten!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Biko-chan didn't just fire up the 
sprinters, she even got Hishi Ama-san to 
take her seriously...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the New Zealand Trophy, Biko 
Pegasus was more of the challenger. But 
today—
choice_data_list: Yeah, all eyes are on you!
Yeah, all eyes are on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are completely evenly matched. Biko 
Pegasus meets Hishi Amazon's challenge, 
which almost feels like a sign of
respect, 
head-on.
